name: dsh-bigger-choice
description: Enlarges the built-in composer model picker's popup (taller and wider) so one screen shows many more models, adds 免费 (free-only) and 收藏 (favorites) filter toggles next to the search box that combine with each other, lets you star models inline (hover star, persistent star + emphasized row), and sorts each provider's models cheapest-first. Client-only: it injects one stylesheet that overrides the host popup's box (which the host then measures and places as usual) plus a small DOM controller for the toggles, stars, filters and price sort.

meta.title: 更大的模型选择框
meta.description: 把输入框右下角模型选择器的下拉框放大：最高 78vh、最宽 720px，一屏能直接看到十几个模型；搜索框右侧有「免费」「收藏」两枚开关（可叠加筛选），鼠标指向模型行出现星星、点一下即收藏（收藏行常驻星星并加重底色，收藏清单存在浏览器本地）；每个提供商内部按价格从低到高排序，免费的最前、没标价格的垫底。
